source: Starting point, not official. Rafa Gutierrez (Danny Gomez interview, 2018): an early manager imposed a Roland Jazz Chorus ('super limpio'); his board was one or two distortions, a chorus, a tuner, a compressor as solo boost. No song-specific gear found for 'Te quiero' (La cagaste... Burt Lancaster, 1986). FD TWIN-R (bright Fender clean) stands in for the JC-120, ChorusOne for its built-in chorus. Clean choice and all values are estimates.
